title: Legora announces brand partnership with tennis champion and entrepreneur, Venus Williams
summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced a strategic partnership with tennis champion and entrepreneur, Venus Williams.
body_markdown:
The partnership brings together Legora and one of the most accomplished and inspiring competitors in the history of sports, united by a shared belief that excellence is built over time: through preparation, precision, consistency, and the confidence to perform when the pressure is highest.


Williams’ career is defined by an extraordinary standard of excellence sustained across decades. A seven-time Grand Slam singles champion, five-time Wimbledon singles champion, four-time Olympic gold medalist and trailblazer for equity in sport, Williams embodies what it means to build a legacy over time at its highest level: mastery earned through consistency, resilience, and an ambition that extends on and off the court. She is a successful entrepreneur and the founder of V Starr, an award-winning design firm, co-founder of Happy Viking, and an investor and ambassador for WeWard, extending her impact across sports and entertainment, health and wellness, business and entrepreneurship, and fashion and design.


That same philosophy is central to Legora’s work with the world’s leading lawyers.


Founded in 2023, Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 100,000 legal professionals at more than 1,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 50 markets.


In tennis and law, the most defining moments are public. The preparation that goes in them happens out of view. The public doesn’t see the hours spent refining a serve, reading an opponent, rehearsing a response, or pressure-testing a strategy. Everyone sees the point, the argument, the decision. The foundation is built long before the room goes quiet or the ball is in the air.


Williams has built one of the most defining careers in sport through that same commitment to preparation and sustained excellence. Her game has always combined power with precision, instinct with analysis and composure with the ability to continue evolving. She has consistently competed at the highest level while shaping the sport on and off the court.


Legora was built for professionals who operate with the same discipline. Lawyers work in environments where trust is non-negotiable, margins matter and human judgement cannot be outsourced. Legora helps legal teams structure information, surface insight and move faster through complexity, without replacing the expertise that makes great legal work possible.


“Venus Williams embodies the long game,” said Max Junestrand, CEO and co-founder of Legora. “Her career is a study in preparation, control and sustained excellence. She has changed what is possible in her field while staying committed to the work behind the performance. That is exactly the kind of ambition Legora exists to support: professionals who want to compete at the highest level and keep improving over time.”


As part of the strategic partnership, Legora and Williams will collaborate on a series of initiatives exploring preparation, decision-making, and performance under pressure across sport, business, entrepreneurship and leadership. The partnership will also anchor future storytelling and experiences connected to The Long Game, Legora’s sports platform celebrating the serious, often unseen work behind elite performance.


“I’m a firm believer that success is built before even stepping on the court,” said Venus Williams. “Success comes from preparation, consistency, discipline and having the confidence to trust your judgement when the moment calls for it. Legora embodies that same standard in a different arena. They are building technology for professionals who strive to always perform at their best.”


The partnership marks the next step in Legora’s long-term approach to sport, following collaborations with Chelsea Football Club, Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, and Swedish golfer Ludvig Åberg. Together, these partnerships reflect Legora’s belief that the highest performers in every field share a common standard: they prepare thoroughly, improve continuously, and show up when it matters.


For Legora, sport is not about spectacle. It is a language for the values the company was built on: precision, control, consistency, mastery and ambition. It is a way to recognize the people Legora builds for, and the work they do long before the outcome is visible.


That is the long game.
